name: Algebraic Variety Framing with Explicit Connectivity Bridge
description: Recasts the problem as selecting hyperplanes to form an algebraic variety where critical variables are identical. To satisfy the expert critique and prevent semantic drift, it explicitly states the exact graph-theoretic equivalence (connected components). It also includes a decoy warning against sum-of-squares aggregation to disrupt the models' confidence in linear shortest-path costs without altering the mathematical objective.
